title: Continuity in the scale of radial cutoff integrals against an integrable weight
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and E = Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, with the Euclidean norm and Borel σ-algebra. Let μ be any measure on E, g: E → ℝ, ψ: ℝ → ℝ, ξ ∈ E, and c, σ, ρ, R ∈ ℝ with σ > 0, c > 0 and cρ < R. Assume g is μ-integrable on the closed ball B_R(ξ), ψ is continuous, and ψ(t) = 0 for every t > c. Then the map τ ↦ ∫_E g(x)·ψ(|x − ξ|/τ) dμ(x) is continuous on [σ, ρ].
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (g : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ψ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (c σ ρ R : ℝ), 0 < σ → 0 < c → c * ρ < R → IntegrableOn g (closedBall ξ R) μ → Continuous ψ → (∀ t, c < t → ψ t = 0) → ContinuousOn (fun τ ↦ ∫ x, g x * ψ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) ∂μ) (Icc σ ρ)
